dict.string: EchoNote uses the microphone to capture your voice recordings. For example, you can record lectures, meetings, interviews, or personal voice memos that are saved to your library for later playback.
EchoNote uses your location to automatically tag recordings with where they were made. For example, a recording made at a coffee shop will include that location in its details.
EchoNote uses speech recognition to transcribe your recordings into text, so you can read and search through what was said.
ClearVoice uses this identifier to deliver personalized ads and measure ad performance. You can opt out at any time.
